tagline: 柯达便携相机，1996 年发布
description: 柯达于1996年推出的便携相机。配备1:4.5-1:8.5/30-60mm zoom lens, glass hybrid aspheric。快门速度programmed electronic shutter with speeds 1/6 - 1/270 sec.。active autofocus (infrared?)。

specs.快门: programmed electronic shutter with speeds 1/6 - 1/270 sec.
specs.取景器: real image finder with parallax marks and autofocus indicator
specs.闪光灯: flash on, off or automatic, long time synchronization
specs.英文简介: The Advantix 4100 ix zoom is a compact zoom camera mad eby Kodak for the APS film system in about 1996.The user's manual at Kodak (linked below) includes a 1995 copyright statement; however, the Advantix cameras were not introduced until 1996.
